name: Marcus Chen
psychographics: Values efficiency and work-life integration; believes time is the most scarce resource.
current_solutions: Uses DoorDash Premium for lunch, HelloFresh for dinners, and Notion AI to generate weekly shopping lists.
frustration: The HelloFresh box arrived at 9 PM on a Tuesday after he worked late; the ice packs had melted, and the vegetables were limp, forcing him to throw away $45 worth of produce.
decision_style: Compares subscription costs instantly on credit card apps; switches services if a better promo code appears within two weeks.
voice: Blunt and direct; often multitasks while speaking, so sentences are short and focused on getting to the point.
